_note: Hand-written sync: the API (generic tenant-scoped read, RPC writes, transaction/NOTIFY helper), the WebSocket server (LISTEN + broadcast), auth, bootstrap, members and demo data are `server` (role checks in permissions.server.ts and src/roles.ts count as `permissions`); the client's fetch, query builder, subscribe, cache and write code is `data`. SQL migrations and schema.ts (row types, readable tables/relations) are schema; Better Auth's tables come from its own migrations. src/scenarios.ts and src/fixtures.ts feed the demo-data route, as in the Jazz copy. scripts/ and harness.mjs are bench plumbing.
